name: Affan Khamse
bio: Based in New York City. I turn AI prototypes into systems that hold up in production. At Centh AI, a South Park Commons backed startup, I own the credentialing agent. It verifies clinicians against 50+ official sources, approves the documents it can prove, and sends only the unclear cases to a credentialer. Before that, I cut an AI call assistant's latency by more than half at Novum AI.
